confirm.consent: Review the handover time, photos and surcharges. By confirming, you agree to pay all displayed surcharges (late return, excess mileage and selected additional fees) with the chosen method; amounts not yet confirmed by the owner or not collectable from your wallet remain payable. If anything is wrong, open a dispute before confirming.
confirm.paymentHintNone: Choose how to pay the surcharges before confirming. Nothing is charged until you choose.
confirm.paymentHintWallet: Charged from your wallet after you agree; if the balance is short, top up and pay the rest.
confirm.paymentHintExternal: No wallet deduction. The owner confirms once the full amount is received in cash or by separate transfer.
confirm.handoverBody: Only continue after you have handed over the vehicle and checked the record. Nothing is charged at this step.
confirm.footer: After you confirm, the owner confirms receipt of the vehicle to complete the trip. Confirming receipt of surcharges is a separate step.
